questions.stem: In a 50-year-old patient with a recent diagnosis of a pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor, laboratory investigations reveal disruptions in glucose regulation with both elevated insulin and glucagon levels. In understanding the role of somatostatin in pancreatic function, which statement accurately describes its physiological impact?
questions.stemHtml: In a 50-year-old patient with a recent diagnosis of a pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor, laboratory investigations reveal disruptions in glucose regulation with both elevated insulin and glucagon levels. In understanding the role of somatostatin in pancreatic function, which statement accurately describes its physiological impact?

options.label: A
options.text: Somatostatin stimulates the Secretion of Insulin and Glucagon.

options.label: B
options.text: Somatostatin is produced by Alpha Cells in the Pancreas.

options.label: C
options.text: Somatostatin has no impact on Glucose Regulation.

options.label: D
options.text: Somatostatin inhibits the Secretion of Insulin and Glucagon
